reinstate.name: Neutral-Grip Dumbbell Bench Press
reinstate.why: The agent's reason was wrong: the standard dumbbell press is pronated or slightly angled; a palms-facing press changes shoulder position and elbow path and is a recognised, attested variant under EL-2 (grip changes the demand).

reinstate.name: Landmine Clean
reinstate.why: Attested in athletic strength and conditioning as a named landmine power movement; power work is never_auto per EL-5.

newFamilies.why: Two inventories rejected sandbag movements only because the vocabulary lacked the implement. Sandbags are common home and garage equipment with a distinct shifting-load demand; a small attested family is in scope, cardio-style drills are not.

upheld: Every other rejection in every inventory stands as recorded, including all cardio rejections.
